marketing_description: The DeWALT DCB205C Battery and Charger Starter Kit is designed for use with DeWALT 20 V MAX Tools and features a 20 V, 5 Ah lithium-ion battery with a 100 W-hr energy rating. This kit includes a rapid charger for quick recharging and has a compact design for easy storage. The battery has a 3-LED fuel gauge to indicate the state of charge.
